description: Track your bike's service history, documents, and insurance with ease.
_comment_background: SPLASH IS ICON-ORANGE BY CHOICE. background_color and theme_color are #FB6900, the exact orange of the icon tile (measured off icon-512), so the splash is one unbroken orange field with the logo sitting in it. That means one visible seam remains: when the splash hands over to the app, the whole screen goes from bright orange to the near-black app, and the status bar drops from orange to the #3d1908 the theme-color meta in index.html carries. That flash is the price of an orange splash over a dark app and was accepted over the alternative (a dark splash the orange tile clashed with). icon-192's transparent rounded corners are invisible on this field, so the two icons needed no change. Do not 'fix' these back to dark to match the app — that reintroduces the clash this change removes.
